'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Mitchell Hensley LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitchell Hensley]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Mind Your Own Business
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
